answer: Shards are assigned from the quartz graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The inlet assignment is published and ledge records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 2182 identities would post 3220 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
